Case study / ML

Breast Cancer ML Optimization

Problem

Evaluate whether feature selection and hyperparameter optimization can improve classification performance while reducing the number of input variables.

Approach

  • Random Forest classification with a custom Genetic Algorithm.
  • Compare baseline and optimized models on the original holdout.
  • Reduce the input set from 30 to 9 features.

Results and limitations

Saved-configuration replay: 98.25% test accuracy versus 95.61% baseline, on the same 114-sample holdout. ROC AUC stayed at 0.9937. The full GA search was not rerun in V2. Research only; no external or clinical validation.

Case study / CV

Sports Player Tracking

Problem

Detect and track players in sports video as a foundation for automated match analytics.

Approach

  • YOLOv8 for detection and DeepSORT for tracking.
  • Grey Wolf Optimization in the original detection experiment.
  • V2 refactors tracking and analytics logic and includes automated core tests.

Results and limitations

The historical detection experiment reported 94.01% mAP@50 for GWO YOLOv8n versus 93.80% baseline. V2 has 17 passing core tests in the archived test report; it was not retrained or benchmarked on real match video. No tracking accuracy claim is made.
